neighbours.label: something coming from a different place or group than the one in focus: 'from another/other/neighbouring/nearby <place or group>'
fire: The team borrowed two goalkeepers from another club for the tournament.
A specialist was brought over from a different department to review the case.
Families from neighbouring villages of the valley used to gather here every autumn.
The museum has several paintings on loan from other galleries in the region.
Students who transfer from another university must submit their records.
The mod lets you import characters from other games in the series.
Volunteers arrived from nearby towns to help clear the debris.
The recipe uses a spice blend brought in from a neighbouring province.
quiet: The team trained two goalkeepers for the tournament this summer.
A specialist reviewed the case carefully on Thursday afternoon.
Families in the valley used to gather here every autumn.
The museum has several paintings in its main hall.
Students who enrol late must submit their records by Friday.
The mod lets you rename characters and change their outfits.
Volunteers worked all night to help clear the debris.
The recipe uses a spice blend made fresh every morning.

notes: Card: ' in', ' from', ' Nadu', ' систем', ' to' with no single token: 'from Emmanuel Church in Newport', 'come over from another school', 'from neighbouring areas of Tamil Nadu', 'из других игровых систем'. Probes: 'from another hospital' 0.76, 'from neighbouring districts' 0.48, 'from other game systems' 0.46, 'from a church in the next town' 0.33; 'with other organizations' 0.17, same sentences without the outside source < 0.06.
